.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1024 mb high was around 550 nautical miles west of 
Point Reyes and a 1010 mb low was over Arizona. Weak offshore 
flow during nights and mornings will alternate with northwest 
onshore flow during afternoons and evenings through Wednesday. 
Offshore flow will begin to prevail and strengthen Thursday, peak 
Friday into Saturday, and weaken late Saturday.
